concept: DB migration: SCT for schema + DMS with CDC for heterogeneous migration
tests: Which tools are needed to migrate Oracle → Aurora PostgreSQL with schema conversion and minimal downtime.
expected: AWS SCT converts Oracle schema and code → PostgreSQL; AWS DMS moves the data with ongoing replication (CDC) until cutover. Triggers: "Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL", "converting the schema", "minimizing downtime".
why_not: Snowball — offline shipping, doesn't convert engines or replicate; DataSync — files, not databases; Kinesis — not a schema migration tool.
